run_relax_jobs: run parallel SLURM jobs to relax crystal structures from parquet files using UMA ML potentials
relax_structures: relax crystal structures from a parquet file and save relaxed CIF outputs with energy and density
relax_atoms: relax a single ASE Atoms crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or LBFGS optimizers with optional cell relaxation
relax_atoms_batch: relax a batch of ASE Atoms structures simultaneously using FAIRChem's LBFGS torch optimizer on GPU
create_calculator: create a FAIRChemCalculator with a pretrained UMA ML potential predictor for crystal structure relaxation
